capturedInterval.limitation: Materialized midpoint rounds to Float32; nearestAt interpolates endpoint Float32 values in JS double.

canonicalTopology: Explicit sourceIndex validates each oriented patch source ordinal once. Wardrobe.fullIndex remains canonical while body.geometry.index may be compacted/replaced. The body geometry/skeleton must retain identity during an updater lifetime.
atomicity: Stage all sampled positions/normals and current/union bounds first; advanceHistory/reset publish only after validation and final live check. Failed late getters and disposal leave the previous public state unchanged.
limitations: CPU correctness/lifecycle; no GPU execution or timing claim.
Union bounds cover linear vertex interpolation, not nonlinear skeletal motion or continuous collision detection.
Open-patch normal sign is not a closed-body inside test.
No performance claim, GPU query execution, calibration activation, full contact/visual acceptance or full repository suite.
